# Nullable Boolean

ONF typed decoder outputs v1.

Explicit null or Boolean; omission remains a separate socket-presence state.

Use this named type on matching Encode/Decode sockets. Values are JSON data;
this type performs no network request, model call, authentication, or business action.
Exact type ID and version must agree on both ends of a wire. JSON Schema rejects
incompatible values; formats are informational in ONF. Missing optional fields
and explicit null are different. Unknown fields remain lossless where permitted.
The matching codecs split useful properties or collection entries and reassemble
the original value. They never coerce strings/numbers or silently drop unknown data.

## Schema
```json
{
  "anyOf": [
    {
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    {
      "type": "null"
    }
  ]
}
```

## Example JSON value
```json
false
```

Examples are synthetic. Null, collection, union and presence rules are defined by
the complete schema above; an empty example is not a claim every field is required.
Do not put credentials, tokens, or unnecessary business data into JSON records.

definitions.name: Text List Decode
definitions.description: Expand Text List
definitions.code:
function bounded(v){if(Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(v))>1048576)throw Error('Codec value exceeds 1 MiB');return v;}
const rest=structuredClone(bounded(inputs.value)),index=inputs.index??0,count=rest.length;if(!Number.isSafeInteger(index)||index<0||(count?index>=count:index!==0))throw Error('Index outside list bounds');const out={rest,index,count};if(count)out.item=rest.splice(index,1)[0];return out;
definitions.documentation: Pure reciprocal Text List codec. Exact pinned types validate all values; missing optional fields stay absent, and supported null, false, zero and empty text survive. Unknown object fields use remainder, which cannot collide with declared fields. Maximum serialized value is 1 MiB. No logging, network, secrets, filesystem or durable state. Successful execution follows Next; invalid input fails through On error. List codec: Decode removes one selected item at index (default 0) and exposes the remaining list, original index and count. Encode reinserts optional item at index; connect rest, item and index to reconstruct the value. Empty lists require index 0 and omit item. The rest contract permits empty lists even when the complete value must be nonempty; Encode still enforces the complete list minimum/maximum through its exact output schema.

definitions.description: Assemble Text List
definitions.code:
function bounded(v){if(Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(v))>1048576)throw Error('Codec value exceeds 1 MiB');return v;}
const rest=structuredClone(bounded(inputs.rest)),index=inputs.index??0;if(!Number.isSafeInteger(index)||index<0||index>rest.length)throw Error('Index outside list bounds');if(Object.hasOwn(inputs,'item')&&inputs.item!==undefined)rest.splice(index,0,inputs.item);return {value:bounded(rest)};
